summary: James River Group Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a court ruling on a litigation matter. On June 13, 2026, the Supreme Court, New York County, dismissed the company's claim for specific performance as moot (the transaction closed April 16, 2024) and dismissed consequential damages claims, but allowed breach-of-contract direct damages claims to proceed against Fleming Intermediate Holdings LLC for failing to close the purchase of JRG Reinsurance Company Ltd. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. The filing is a routine legal update, not a special situation. Watch for potential damages award or settlement.
